description:
Argonne National Laboratory (ANL) seeks a Contractor for On-Site Industrial Services. Services include abatement, scaffolding, floor tile removal, window replacement, glazing removal, insulation, and surface preparation and coatings. 

 Award will be made on a  BEST VALUE  basis. Technical acceptability will be evaluated on  AN ADJECTIVAL SCALE. BUSINESS PROPOSALS WILL BE EVALUATED ON PASS/FAIL.  Among responsible offerors determined technically acceptable and compliant with solicitation requirements,  ANL will award to the offeror with the best overall value, where the Technical Proposal is of greater importance to the Price Proposal and Business Management Proposal.   

   Proposals are due by 10:00 AM CST on December 7, 2026.      

 *All inquiries or questions must be submitted in writing prior to 3:00 PM CST on November 27, 2026.   

 Offerors shall submit: 

 
	 Completed proposal that meets the requirements stated in the Request for Proposal Document (Technical Proposal, Business/Management Proposal, and Price Proposal) 
	 Completed and signed ANL-70B Representations and Certifications. 
	 Any proposed exceptions or deviations. 
	  All proposal documentation requested under Best Value Evaluation Criteria (Enclosure 5)  
 

 Offers that do not meet mandatory requirements or do not provide adequate supporting documentation may be found technically unacceptable.
